reason: The terminal exact-Newton polish no longer globalizes in stationarity-residual currency: #2861 (landed in the codex integration d82efb558) accepts polish steps on Armijo decrease of the penalized objective, because on a resolved negative-curvature mode the objective-descent direction can raise the KKT residual and the old rule rejected exactly the step that leaves the saddle. reason: Historical acknowledgement for 65c63d9df (#2668): the quasi-Laplace complexity now charges the joint log-det, 1/2 log|A| + rank charge, instead of 1/2 (log|A| - log|A_tt|) + rank charge. Subtracting the coordinate block removed the only place the ARD precision entered the complexity, while loss.ard kept its -1/2 n log(alpha) normalizer, so V fell linearly in log alpha on a collapsing axis. With the coordinate block gone, `coordinate_block_logdet_theta_adjoint` and every coordinate-only gradient leg were deleted, and threshold_gate_coordinate_block_theta_adjoint_matches_finite_difference_2500, which differenced that helper, had nothing left to measure.
